sloka: रुद्रः प्रीतो ऽभवत्तस्मै वरं दातुं ययौ च सः ।बहुमानाच्च रुद्रेण दत्तस्तस्याद्भुतो वरः ।। ७.६१.६ ॥
transliteration: rudraḥ prīto 'bhavattasmai varaṁ dātuṁ yayau ca saḥ ।bahumānācca rudreṇa dattastasyādbhuto varaḥ ।। 7.61.6 ॥

translations.english: Rudra became pleased with him and went to grant a boon, and with great respect, an extraordinary boon was given to him by Rudra.
